mentions.name: Meso plant care platform
mentions.description: A biodiversity and climate platform that takes care of plants. The online portion is mostly complete at meso.cloud/plants, and a glass grow box with lighting prototypes is being built to be driven by the platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Biodiversity & climate platform that takes care of your plants.

Online part mostly done at https://www.meso.cloud/plants/, currently building glass grow box and light prototypes that will be driven by it.
